We need DBE for C11H6O4S. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens). For heteroatoms like S (group 16) similar to O, does not affect DBE. So DBE = 11 - 6/2 + 1 = 11 -3 +1 =9. No nitrogens. So DBE = 9.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
